stage0098a_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$シモン$$
「I'm counting on you to protect Earth, $$ロシウ$$」

stage0098a_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ロシウ$$
「No matter what happens, I will protect it」

stage0098a_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$キノン$$
「$$シベラ$$, I'm counting on you to operate
　the $$超銀河ダイグレン$$」

stage0098a_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$シベラ$$
「I'm a member of the Dai-Gurren Brigade too.
　I'll give it my all.」

stage0098a_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$レディ$$
「$c... I'm entrusting you with Earth's fate」

stage0098a_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$レイアム$$
「The forces left on Earth are standing
　by in various locations, bracing for
　an attack by $$バアル$$ and the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$」

stage0098a_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$メラン$$
「Neo Zeon, too, is strengthening colony
　defenses under $$ハマーン・カーン$$'s command」

stage0098a_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ブライト$$
「So we're just the one bullet
　Earth had prepared for us, huh...」

stage0098a_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「But everyone's hopes and feelings
　are entrusted to it」

stage0098a_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That's why this one strike
　has to decide it」

stage0098a_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「For the future of Earth...
　of humanity」

stage0098a_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ロージェノム$$, if you would」

stage0098a_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Preparing to activate the Spiral
　Realm Perception Transfer System!」

stage0098a_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「$$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$'s homeworld built an isolated
　universe in the gap between dimensions, evading
　Super-Spiral detection. This was beyond my calculations」

stage0098a_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「The universe is ambiguity.
　It becomes fixed only once perceived.
　That is the principle of this universe...」

stage0098a_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Even within an isolated universe, matter
　that has once been perceived responds
　to Spiral detection」

stage0098a_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「...What kind of spell is that?」

stage0098a_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「In other words, if someone within
　that isolated universe perceives its existence,
　it becomes a physical object detectable from our world too」

stage0098a_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「So $$次元力$$ falls under that
　same principle too, huh」

stage0098a_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$次元力$$... $$オリジン・ロー$$...
　$$アサキム$$ and the others called it the
　power of the Origin Principle too」

stage0098a_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$赤木$$
（You're not supposed to let that show.
　Stay quiet and you look smart）

stage0098a_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I don't get any of it, old man!
　Explain it simpler!」

stage0098a_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$クルツ$$
（He said what we couldn't bring ourselves to say!
　That's what gives me chills, that's what I admire!）

stage0098a_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$青山$$
（You've completely lost to a grade-schooler
　in maturity, you...）

stage0098a_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$リーロン$$
「$$ワッ太$$'s got a point.
　Well, simply put...」

stage0098a_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$リーロン$$
「$$ニア$$, who's in that isolated universe,
　didn't forget something precious to her,
　even with her mind controlled by the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$」

stage0098a_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$リーロン$$
「The ring $$シモン$$ gave her.
　That was the only thing we could search for
　from here」

stage0098a_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$リーロン$$
「That's right!
　We found the universe where $$シモン$$
　and $$ニア$$'s feelings were hidden away」

stage0098a_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$キタン$$
「Guess that means love conquers all!」

stage0098a_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Protecting the universe with love and spirit!
　Isn't that just like the Dai-Gurren Brigade!」

stage0098a_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's throw in effort and guts too,
　while we're at it!」

stage0098a_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$甲児$$
「And hot blood and courage too!」

stage0098a_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$シベラ$$
「Spiral Realm Perception Transfer System,
　activation preparations complete!」

stage0098a_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「$c, all ships, dive into the space
　opened up by the $$超銀河ダイグレン$$!」

stage0098a_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$リーロン$$
「As long as you stay within this ship's
　field, you won't get separated」

stage0098a_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All ships, follow the $$超銀河ダイグレン$$!」

stage0098a_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Activating the Spiral Realm
　Perception Transfer System!」

stage0098a_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$シモン$$
「Let's go!
　This is the final battle!!」
